scripts.build: npm run build -w @praditacare/shared && npm run build -w @praditacare/api && npm run build -w @praditacare/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web "npm run dev -w @praditacare/shared" "npm run dev -w @praditacare/api" "npm run dev -w @praditacare/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @praditacare/api && npm run typecheck -w @praditacare/web
